newsitem.title: USA: Equity Inns to buy 28 Hampton Inns.
newsitem.headline: Equity Inns to buy 28 Hampton Inns.

text.p: Equity Inns Inc said on Monday that it has entered into agreements to acquire 28 Hampton Inn hotels with an aggregate of 3,487 rooms in 14 states for approximately $182 million.
Equity Inns is buying the hotels from a series of partnerships controlled by Growth Hotel Investors and Growth Hotel Investors II, the company said.
The purchase prices include franchisor required renovations and franchise transfer fees, Equity Inns said.
Equity Inns said the hotels are located principally in the southeastern and midwestern United States in major urban and suburban markets.
The agreements provide for a due diligence period which expires April 28, 1997, during which Equity Inns may terminate the agreements for any reason, the company said.
The purchase and sale of the hotels are subject to the requisite approvals of the limited partners of Growth Hotel Investors and other real estate closing conditions, Equity Inns said.
